feed.title: Apple Says iPhone 18 Pro Max Units That Lost AT&T Service Need Replacement, Not a Fix
feed.summary: Apple has confirmed that a cellular connectivity issue affecting some iPhone 18 Pro Max devices on AT&T's network requires unit replacement rather than a software fix for already-affected phones. While iOS 27.0.1 and a carrier settings update act as preventive measures, they cannot restore service on devices already in SOS mode. The cause of the fault, which primarily impacts the US iPhone 18 Pro Max model using a Qualcomm modem, has not been disclosed, and Apple states only a "small number" of users are affected despite thousands of complaints.

feed.title: Adobe Forecasts 130% Surge in AI-Driven Retail Traffic During US Holiday Season
feed.summary: Adobe predicts a significant 130% increase in AI-driven retail traffic to US websites this holiday season, outperforming growth from paid search and social media. This surge is attributed to consumers using AI for product research, which boosts purchase confidence and reduces returns. Overall, US online holiday sales are expected to reach $275.1 billion, with Cyber Monday remaining the biggest shopping day.

feed.title: AI Retail Referrals Set to Rise 130% as Adobe Forecasts $275.1 Billion Holiday Season
feed.summary: Adobe predicts a significant increase in AI-driven retail referrals for the upcoming holiday shopping season, with a 130% year-over-year rise. The company forecasts total US online spending to reach $275.1 billion, driven by categories like electronics, apparel, and groceries, and expects "Buy Now, Pay Later" transactions to account for $21.3 billion. Mobile devices are also anticipated to play a dominant role in holiday e-commerce, contributing 63% of online spending on Thanksgiving and 57.4% of overall holiday spending.
